name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: The official rulebook and starter kit for building add-ons to the Cursor AI coding editor.
buyer: A developer-tools company that wants their product — a database, API, or framework — to show up natively inside Cursor for every developer who uses it.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools company builds an official Cursor plugin so developers discover and use their API without leaving their editor.
A freelance developer builds and sells niche Cursor plugins for popular frameworks that don't have official support yet.
An enterprise builds an internal plugin that wires company style guides and proprietary APIs directly into every engineer's Cursor.

money_ideas.idea: Build plugins for paying B2B clients who want their SDK wired directly into Cursor as a growth and support channel.
Offer a premium plugin tier with advanced features (proprietary data access, extra linting) behind a paywall.

steal_this: Pick a popular API or framework with no Cursor plugin yet, build a minimal one this weekend, and publish it before anyone else claims the niche.
